L145: # EU28 current account surplus 32.2 bn euro - Products Euro Indicators
L146: ## Publication Details
L147: 
L148: EU28 current account surplus 32.2 bn euro
L149: 
L150: The EU28 seasonally adjusted external current account recorded a surplus of 32.2 billion euro (1.0% of GDP) in the first quarter of 2014, compared with a surplus of 36.3 bn (1.1% of GDP) in the fourth quarter of 2013 and with a surplus of 34.9 bn (1.1% of GDP) in the first quarter of 2013, according to first estimates from Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union.
